Plot the course of a CAT session

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_cat_trajectory.Rd

An interactive plotly chart in two panels side by side: the standardized ability estimate and its standard error after each answer, across the whole test, one colour per scale. Hovering a point shows the statement and the answer; a dashed line marks the standard error at which a scale stops.

Usage

plot_cat_trajectory(s)

Arguments

s

A CAT session with at least one answer (see cat_start).

Value

A plotly htmlwidget.

See also

Other CAT session: cat_answer(), cat_item(), cat_results(), cat_start()

Examples

q <- read_questionnaire(example_questionnaires()[3])
s <- cat_start(q, scales = c("Openness", "Extraversion"), se_threshold = 0.5)
while (s$stage == "testing") s <- cat_answer(s, sample(1:5, 1))
plot_cat_trajectory(s)
